hooks.command: jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty" | { read -r f || exit 0; case "$f" in *.kt|*.kts|*.yml|*.yaml|*.md|*.toml|*.sh|*.json) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$f" in "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"/*) ;; /*) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; hits=$(LC_ALL=C grep -c "[^ -~	]" "$f" 2>/dev/null || true); [ "${hits:-0}" -gt 0 ] && printf "%s" "{\"systemMessage\":\"$f has $hits line(s) with non-ASCII characters. The pre-commit no-non-ascii hook rejects these in Kotlin, YAML, Markdown, TOML, shell and JSON. Localized text belongs in res/values-<lang>/strings.xml, which is exempt.\"}"; exit 0; }
